narrative: The company's narrow book open on a chest beside the trestle. One fresh line. The rolls lie under the weight, out of the writing. No total is struck. No face. The next line is blank. No one's name is written as giver. The small sign is not drawn in the margin. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the line and left the next one blank.
